The pinned shared venv (graphifyy[gemini,sql]==0.9.32) at ~/.claude/tools/graphify/.venv is created lazily by /graphify-init's own preflight on first use, never shipped by the installer. The backend key is covered by this manifest's existing GEMINI_API_KEY advisory_smoke_test above — no new entry needed. D4's V1 (does `graphify extract --code-only`'s report count include non-code files, or only parsed code files?) and V2 (does the discovery walk honour .gitignore?) are REQUIRED one-time empirical verifications before the metered full-extraction path may be trusted in any environment, per ADR-054 D4. **RUN 2026-08-01** against this repo (claude-code-stack, doc-heavy anchor) using graphifyy 0.9.32 in the pinned venv at ~/.claude/tools/graphify/.venv, `graphify extract . --code-only --no-cluster`. Verbatim stdout: `[graphify extract] --code-only: skipping 359 non-code file(s) (359 docs, 0 papers, 0 images) — no LLM extraction` then `[graphify extract] found 165 code, 0 docs, 0 papers, 0 images` (12 more files unclassified/skipped), then `wrote .../graph.json — 2360 nodes, 3031 edges`. **V1 result: the report counts ONLY parsed code files (165), not the full file-discovery-walk total (524) — it reports code and non-code counts as two separate numbers, never conflated.** This is the second branch in D4's V1 decision rule: step 4's projection basis falls back to the step-3a ECS enumeration (`git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard`) rather than this report's own code count, and D5's calibration-band label must note the denominator is a git inventory, not graphify's own report. **V2 result: CONFIRMED — the discovery walk honours .gitignore.** A canary file (`tools/graphify/__pycache__/canary_module.py`, real Python class+function content, sitting inside a directory matched by this repo's own `__pycache__/` gitignore rule, confirmed ignored via `git check-ignore -v`) was placed before the run and searched for after: zero occurrences of `canary` or `__pycache__` in either `manifest.json` (165 entries, exactly the parsed-code count, no canary) or `graph.json` (2360 nodes, 3031 edges, grep for both strings returns 0 hits). The walk never reached the canary. This proves `dispatch ⊆ ECS` holds for this graphify version/config, so D6's egress heuristic is sound and step 3a stands as written — the metered full-extraction path in `/graphify-extract` is CLEARED to run against real repos, D4's precondition satisfied. Canary file and temp output directory were deleted after the run; nothing from this verification is tracked in git. This --code-only run performed no LLM dispatch (per `graphify --help`: \"index code (local AST, no API key)\"), so no cost/tokens were incurred and no `calibration.jsonl` entry applies — V1/V2 are structural verifications, not calibration runs."
